# Current: bridge at 16-40, green at c30-33, red at c36-39, both at r13-16
# Blue at r19-22, c42-45
# Move down to blue row, extend to touch blue, retract to pick up
result = action(['DOWN', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'LEFT'])
print(f"DOWN,RIGHT,RIGHT,LEFT: bc={result.get('board_changed')}, done={result.get('done')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
bridge_cols = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['w', 'g'] and n['pixels'] <= 4:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        if 12 <= min(rows) <= 23:
            bridge_cols.extend(cols)
print(f"  Bridge: {min(bridge_cols)}-{max(bridge_cols)}")

for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N'] and n['pixels'] == 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        if min(rows) < 50:
            print(f"  {n['color']}: r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

if result.get('done'):
    print("LEVEL COMPLETE!")
</parameter>
